landed: frontend: MiniApp 落位副本的 source/ 由 projectSources() 从该树 src/ 逐字节投影而来，与树内同文本，故锚在副本上唯一命中；改后的字节只进用户配置目录下的副本，取件步于树内零字节写入。
description: The route titles carry word-table keys and the window title resolves them. Anchors stand on the exported hook and the route table each title sits in; they name the route a title belongs to rather than a position in the table.
